shots.action: He holds the envelope with both hands and smiles gently, coworkers clap softly behind him, one blink.
The son talks with a small pleading hand gesture; the father slowly opens the bankbook and looks down at it.
The daughter rubs her clasped hands and leans forward slightly; the father listens and blinks.
The young man jingles the car keys and grins; the father taps his phone once and smiles faintly.
His fingers tighten slightly on the bankbook, eyebrows draw together, a slow tired breath.
He looks down at his phone, his thumb scrolls once, then he lowers the phone slowly. Steam rises faintly from the food.
He slowly lifts a spoonful of soup, pauses, then lowers it; the hanging lamp sways very slightly.
He looks out of the window, then down at the bankbook in his hand; the city lights twinkle softly.
The grandfather hands the money and smiles; the child jumps a little with joy; leaves sway in the breeze.
